info.name: Student App API (roles)
info.description: Run the folders in order. Each role folder logs in first. Set adminPassword, hrPassword, and employeePassword in the collection variables before running. Start the app with SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD, SEED_HR_PASSWORD, SEED_EMPLOYEE_PASSWORD set to the same values, and with --app.jwt.cookie-secure=false for plain HTTP.

variable.description: Password for test users created by the run

item.name: 1. Public and admin login
item.description: Creates a public account, then logs in as admin. The cookie jar keeps the last login, so each role folder logs in first.

request.description: Public registration always creates an EMPLOYEE. Expect 201.

exec: pm.test("status is 201 and role is EMPLOYEE", function () {

request.description: Needs ADMIN_PASSWORD set in the collection variables. Sets the access_token cookie.

exec: pm.test("status is 200 and cookie is stored", function () {
